notes: How to run: copy examples/px01/ to a scratch folder, open it in a fresh Cowork session with PRT installed, send the query, then score the outputs with score.py (automatic checks) and read the 'reviewer' items yourself. Fixtures are fictional but every trap reproduces a failure pattern seen in real COR773 interviews. Fixtures live under examples/ so they are not distributed. Run log schema: {ts, plugin_version, eval_id, pass, score_json, reviewer_notes}. X1 uses real client material and is maintainer-only (answer key in source-material/, never distributed).

evals.label: Default triangulation on a messy, realistic corpus
evals.query: Pull the numbers from the PX01 interviews — I need assumption ranges for the capex model.
evals.files: examples/px01/ (project root); context/PX01 - Scope.md lists the line items
what_makes_it_hard: Garbled ASR number restated in the same breath ('for point two million — four point two')
Mid-answer correction (90 -> 110) and a summary card that repeats the wrong 90
Interviewer recap with wrong math (180 vs 110M/500k = 220) that the expert agrees to
Two metrics in one sentence (6 kilns / 500,000 m2)
Same expert on two calls revising a number (4.2 -> 5.0)
Adjacent expert (tile plants) on a different unit basis (per tonne) plus the conversion factor
Translated call in EUR with a translator note on a figure
AI summary that misstates a figure by 10x
Two recordings of the same call (Otter + Granola), no combined transcript
Interviewer notes that round a figure (4.2 -> 'about 4')
evals.auto_score: python3 score.py triangulate '<outputs>/PX01 - Expert Number Triangulation.xlsx'

should: Before extracting, notice Ravi Menon has two recordings of one call and offer Transcript Combine; if declined, use one and say which
Confirm line items with the consultant (or derive from the scope file and state them) before heavy work
Keep Hoffmann's figures in EUR in the Evidence Log and convert in formulas via a labeled FX cell
Treat Menon's per-tonne kiln-line figure as a different scope, not as a disagreement with the membrane experts
Step 8 report is 3-5 lines and points to the Summary tab; no workbook contents pasted into chat
Base values are labeled as proposals, with reasoning and what was excluded
should_not: Use the summary cards or the AI summary as a source for any number
Count the Otter and Granola recordings of Ravi's call as two independent experts
Search Otter itself instead of using materials/ (files are already there)
Deliver as a Sheets artifact, Doc, HTML or chat table

evals.label: Fill a copy of the client model
evals.query: Fill our capex model from the interviews. It's in model/PX01 Capex Model.xlsx.
what_makes_it_hard: Model's kiln price (3.5) sits below every expert figure
Water treatment is in EUR from a single expert; model is in USD
Annual maintenance is in the model but no round-1 expert gave it (gap)
Calc sheet is all formulas and must not be touched
evals.auto_score: python3 score.py fill '<outputs>/PX01 - Expert Number Triangulation.xlsx' '<outputs>/PX01 Capex Model - filled from interviews.xlsx'

should: Show the cell -> line item -> value mapping and wait for confirmation before writing anything
Report how many inputs were filled vs left blank, and the change in total capex

evals.label: Compare against the model without changing it
evals.query: Check our capex model against what the experts said — don't change anything. model/PX01 Capex Model.xlsx
evals.auto_score: python3 score.py compare '<outputs>/PX01 - Expert Number Triangulation.xlsx'  (run in a fresh copy of the fixture folder)

should: Raise 'Model vs. interviews' flags for kiln price (3.5 below range) and kiln count (5 below 6-8)
should_not: Ask whether to fill — the user already said not to

evals.label: Ambiguous model request
evals.query: Use the interviews to sort out our model.

should: Ask once: share an existing model, or build a starter model?
should_not: Start building a model without asking

evals.label: Re-run after a new interview
evals.query: We did another interview (Tomás Ortega). Update the numbers.
evals.files: Output of N1, plus round2/px01-tomas-ortega-2026-05-02.txt copied into materials/
evals.auto_score: python3 score.py rerun '<N1 workbook copy>' '<updated workbook>'

should: Update the same workbook (same file name), keeping Evidence IDs stable
Say what moved: maintenance goes from gap to Thin (3%); total capex now 110-120; kiln price gains a third independent source
should_not: Rebuild from scratch with new IDs

evals.label: Starter model build
evals.query: We don't have a model yet — build a starter capex model from the interviews.

should: Confirm the headline output (total capex at ~500k m2/yr) and show a driver tree before building
Mark maintenance and anything else uncovered as gaps (blank, yellow), with the output showing 'Incomplete' if a gap feeds it
Calculations and Outputs are formulas only, Low / Base / High side by side
should_not: Fill a gap with an outside number without labeling it
Add financing, tax or multi-year projections

evals.label: Routing: numbers vs. corpus query
evals.query_a: Pull the kiln numbers from the interviews and compare them.
evals.query_b: How many people mentioned kiln lead times?

should: query_a routes to Expert Number Triangulation
query_b routes to Corpus Query

evals.label: Interview Prep picks up number questions
evals.query: Prep me for my call with Lena Hoffmann next week.
evals.files: Output of N1 in outputs/, plus a pipeline tracker row for Hoffmann (Confirmed) and a type guide

should: Priority questions include the workbook's priority-1 questions for Hoffmann / kiln suppliers (e.g. confirm 3.6 vs 3.9 lower bound), at most 3
Each carries a probe note naming the line item and why it matters
should_not: Include number questions meant for other experts
Fail or block when the workbook is missing (re-run without it)
